text: He saw himself lying on the hot sand. <break time="0.8s" /> Near a stream. <break time="0.8s" /> After a cold summer soup. <break time="0.8s" /> While his children. <break time="0.8s" /> Dug in the sand nearby. <break time="0.8s" /> He dozed sweetly. <break time="0.8s" /> Thinking of nothing. <break time="0.8s" /> And feeling. <break time="0.8s" /> That he did not need to go to the office. <break time="0.8s" /> Today, tomorrow, or the day after. <break time="0.8s" /> In the evening. <break time="0.8s" /> After a swim in the river. <break time="0.8s" /> And tea with cream. <break time="0.8s" /> He would take a walk. <break time="0.8s" /> Or play cards with the neighbors. <break time="0.8s" /> Yes, it would be nice to buy an estate. <break time="0.8s" /> Said his wife. <break time="0.8s" /> And it was clear from her face. <break time="0.8s" /> That she was enchanted by her own thoughts. <break time="0.8s" /> Ivan pictured autumn walks. <break time="0.8s" /> By the river. <break time="0.8s" /> And after them. <break time="0.8s" /> The gloomy days. <break time="0.8s" /> When rain fell day and night. <break time="0.8s" /> And there was nowhere to go. <break time="0.8s" /> Ivan stopped walking. <break time="0.8s" /> Looked at his wife. <break time="0.8s" /> And said. <break time="0.8s" /> You know, Masha, I would go abroad. <break time="0.8s" /> He began to think. <break time="0.8s" /> How nice it would be to travel in late autumn. <break time="0.8s" /> To the south of France. <break time="0.8s" /> Or to Italy, or even to India. <break time="0.8s" /> I would certainly go abroad too. <break time="0.8s" /> Said his wife. <break time="0.8s" /> But look at the number of the ticket. <break time="0.8s" /> Walking about the room. <break time="0.8s" /> Ivan suddenly wondered. <break time="0.8s" /> What it would be like if his wife really went abroad with him. <break time="0.8s" /> He pictured her in the train. <break time="0.8s" /> With many bags and baskets. <break time="0.8s" /> Sighing over every coin. <break time="0.8s" /> And complaining. <break time="0.8s" /> That the trip gave her a headache.
